name: StageWebView
description: Webview library for Haxe on Windows (WebView2), Linux (WebKitGTK), macOS and iOS (WKWebView) and Android, with a public webview.WebView API, an optional OpenFL StageWebView facade, hidden webviews, PDF output, direct hxcpp bindings, and a HashLink hdll on Windows.
releasenote: Now a shared library: a framework can build the engines into its own binary through project/Files.xml, and Lime builds them in for lime.ui.WebView. No DLLs ship beside the application. isSupported is a run-time property that checks for the WebView2 Runtime. Developer tools are off in release builds of the OpenFL facade. A cancelled navigation no longer reports an error. See Upgrading from 0.7 in the README.
